description: This file contains the ProgressChartPresenter class responsible for rendering a weekly calories bar chart in an Android app, using custom drawing on a bitmap and a custom ViewHolder.

classes.name: ProgressChartPresenter
classes.description: A Presenter class responsible for creating and binding a bar chart view that visualizes weekly calorie data.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder containing an ImageCardView configured for displaying the chart.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder by drawing a bar chart representing calorie entries on a bitmap and setting it to the ImageCardView.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears the bitmap from the ImageCardView to free resources when the view is unbound.
